$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor validation.

lcovPath.description: Path to the LCOV report generated before the guard runs.

baseBranch.description: Branch used for local diff checks when CI does not provide a target branch.

rootDir.description: Directory that LCOV paths are relative to.

failOnEmpty.description: Fail when the LCOV file is missing or empty.

gitTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for Git commands.

apiTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for GitHub/GitLab API calls.

enabled.description: Publish or update a stable PR/MR coverage comment.

maxFiles.description: Maximum files shown in the PR/MR comment.

maxLinesPerFile.description: Maximum uncovered lines shown per file in the PR/MR comment.

failOnError.description: Fail the guard when publishing the PR/MR comment fails.
